description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git packfile optimization techniques, specifically focusing on delta islands, object delta-base relationships, and packfile ordering heuristics within Git's object storage and repacking process.

methods.name: is_delta_base
methods.description: Function that checks whether a given object ($1) is a delta base for another object ($2) using Git's deltabase info.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Function to create and commit a new Git object with specific content derived from random data and appended seed, and then update references accordingly.
